body_source_topics: Cross-reference to Book I first edition pp.93-99 for sign qualities.
Five categorical groups assigning stature to zodiac signs, not measured height.
Six or more distinct purported indicators for complexion/face/hair involving signs, planetary conditions, fixed stars and humours.
Seasonal descriptions of bodily form, hair, eye shape and temperament.
Explicit historical climate/country proviso: author says a Spaniard/Dane illustration can contradict isolated chart-based colouring.
Conditional stature fallbacks when no planet partile-aspects Lord Ascendant, and when Lord is retrograde or in fall.
Historically disparaging 'deformity', appearance and colour judgments are author claims, not human biometric, ancestry, health or racial evidence.
